name: Sharpe ratio from returns
summary: Sample Sharpe = (mean excess return) / stdev of pasted period returns.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. Excess = return − rf (rf default 0). Not annualised unless your returns already are. Not a live performance GIPS report.
